entities.summary: The Gerald R. Ford Presidential Library is a repository located on the north campus of the University of Michigan in Ann Arbor. The library houses archival materials on the life, career, and presidency of Gerald Ford, the president of the United States from 1974 to 1977. Ford Presidential Library is a part of the National Archives and Records Administrations presidential library system.
